BluePearl Pet Hospital – serving Arden Hills and the Twin Cities.
We are located off Snelling Ave. and Grey Fox Road in Arden Hills, and we serve the surrounding areas of Minneapolis, St. Paul, Columbia Heights, Little Canada, Moundsview, New Brighton, North Oaks, Roseville, Shoreview, Vadnais Heights, White Bear Lake, and more than 500 primary vets in a 100-mile radius of the Twin Cities, including facilities in North Dakota, South Dakota, Canada, Wisconsin, and Iowa.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When you have a pet emergency, seconds count. We want you to know, we’re ready. If your pet has a condition that requires advanced expertise, we’re ready for that too. Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
Call ahead to your BluePearl emergency vet and let us know you’re coming. No appointment is necessary for our emergency vet.
Learn more about your emergency visit

Referral care
Our veterinarians work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our vets are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment.

About BluePearl Pet Hospital Arden Hills.
We strive to match the quality and integrity of animal healthcare with that of human healthcare, and our hospital's state-of-the-art equipment reflects that vision. Our 14,000-square-foot Arden Hills pet hospital has the equipment and staff to give your pets the advanced emergency and referral medical care they deserve.
We care for your pets as if they were our own and tailor every treatment according to their specific needs. We offer an intensive care unit, blood transfusions, C-Arm for placing stents, laparoscopy, arthroscopy, and advanced diagnostic imaging technology, which includes ultrasound, endoscopy, and a 64-slice CT scanner.
Our exam rooms are bright, spacious and comfortable, with separate waiting areas for dogs and cats, an isolated exit and entry for pets with contagious illnesses, and a private comfort room. We always have a veterinarian on staff as our emergency vet services are offered 24 hours a day, seven days a week, including all holidays.

Testimonials.
My story with BluePearl started when my 5 year old husky/malamute Malakai was diagnosed with anal gland adenocarcinoma at his regular vet while getting his anal glands expressed. We got a referral to BluePearl and met with Dr. Kaufman to discuss our surgical options. She was so kind, intelligent, and really made us feel comfortable moving forward with diagnostic scans and surgery. We were so happy to find that his cancer had not spread anywhere else in his body, and surgery was an excellent option. She explained every detail of the surgery with us and included pictures and models to help us understand. She gave us so much of her time and gave us realistic expectations. I trusted her 100% throughout the whole process.
On the day of surgery, she called me personally to let us know how his surgery went, how she navigated through the complications, and how he was doing. She successfully removed his entire tumor despite the significant scar tissue surrounding it. The BluePearl staff also sent me pictures and updates on Malakai throughout the morning and night which put us at ease.
We found out after his tumor was sent to pathology that the cancerous cells may have circulated into Malakai’s bloodstream so we were referred to Dr. Duffy, who is equally phenomenal. She walked us through our options and recommended that we complete some scans to ensure that there weren’t any visible cancerous spots in his body. Everything looked great and per her recommendation, we decided to move forward with chemo to further ward off any cancerous cells that may be in his bloodstream. Dr. Duffy walked us through the different chemo options, the cost associated with chemo, how he may respond, and what his life would look like moving forward.
We recently had a follow up with Dr. Duffy now that we have finished chemo and found out that Malakai’s body is free from cancer. I cried so many happy tears and I am forever grateful to this team. Dr. Duffy walked us through what we need to do moving forward and I put full trust in her recommendations. She always made us feel so welcome, remembered Malakai, and was excited to see his progress.
I will never forget the people who helped me, my dog, and our family on our scariest days. Please, if you need specialty services for your pup and you can make it work financially, take them to BluePearl. There is no limit to the money I would spend to save my dog and this team was worth every single penny.
–Holly G.
